title: Six more select and selection experiments
blurb: A select multiple whose options are chips chosen with a lasso, an input that opens a customisable select with no button, text selected on a plane in perspective, a translation written over the selected sentences, a pulse for each word selected, and selected letters in an input that move in a wave.
question: Can a canvas draw the options of a <select multiple>, can a customisable select with no button serve an <input> as its suggestion list, and does the browser's own text selection still work on text that is drawn in perspective, written over by a translation, or inside an <input>?
result: Yes in Chromium 157, with limits. A canvas inside a list box select is not laid out, so the select goes inside the canvas. showPicker() takes the focus from the input, so it is put back. A selection inside an input has no rectangles, so they are measured.
